name: prompt-coach
description: Rates each prompt before it is sent, says what is missing when it is weak, and offers to improve it with a question or two. Long weak prompts get shaped into a brief.

mode.title: When to check
mode.description: before: rate each prompt before it is sent and offer to improve a weak one; after: send at once and show the rating above the prompt; off

threshold.title: Offer below
threshold.description: Offer to improve a prompt rated below this score (1 to 5); 3 offers on 1 and 2
